name: Velocity Visualization via Geometry Shader Extrusion
definition: A technique to visualize a grid of velocities by rendering short lines with alpha gradients, where line length and direction reflect the velocity vector in each grid cell.
summary: Velocity Visualization via Geometry Shader Extrusion renders velocity grids as alpha-gradient line segments by extruding points into lines using a geometry shader, distinguishing itself through efficient structured grid visualization.
